relevance.rationale: WRONG JOIN - report loudly. The seeded id was faddeev_kashaev1994. This document is arXiv:2109.04664v4 [math.GT], 'On the asymptotic behavior of the colored Jones polynomial of the figure-eight knot associated with a real number', by H. Murakami and A. T. Tran, revised 16 Aug 2022. Second of four uploads in this slice wrongly seeded to faddeev_kashaev1994. No registered key matches: grep for '2109.04664' returns nothing, and the Murakami hits in references.ts are murakami-murakami 2001 and murakami2004, both different papers. Set id to null. Verdict undetermined for the same reason as its siblings: identification settled, relevance not genuinely assessed. From the abstract it is clearly on-topic - it extracts the SL(2;C) Chern-Simons invariant and the adjoint Reidemeister torsion from the N -> infinity asymptotics of the colored Jones of 4_1 evaluated at exp(xi/N) for real xi - and the folio has live figure-eight and torsion-determinant work, so it warrants a real first pass.
